thread:
Priya S.: quick heads-up — noticed a small but reproducible inconsistency for `feature_x_streaming` during the canary. console shows seq=9, a subset of edge clients still evaluating seq=7.
Marco L.: do we have traces or request ids?
Priya S.: trace ids: tx:7f1a, tx:7f1b. runtime logs show client got 304 and kept local payload; proxy response included header X-Seq: 9 but edge-client only validated ETag. proxies seem to pass 304 without body and strip custom headers.
Tariq H.: that matches my quick audit — we rolled the console refactor to add X-Seq as a monotonic sequence id (for easier debug), but we didn't update proxy header passthrough. edge-client still treats 304 == "no change" based only on ETag.
deploy-bot: alert: flag-consistency-scan (feature_x_streaming) mismatch_rate=0.0009 created INC-4892
Marco L.: proposed fix: 1) edge-client fallback: on 304, compare local seq vs server header if present; if header differs, perform full GET. 2) proxy change: forward X-Seq and X-Seq-Prev through CDN. 3) emit metric flag.seq_drift{env,flag,region} and flag.seq_fetch(reason=304_retry). 4) dashboard tile: Flag Sync Integrity with per-flag heatmap. 5) console toggle rollouts.pause_on_seq_drift (default on for critical flags).
Priya S.: test matrix: unit test for 304->GET, integration job that bumps seq header and asserts client observes new payload within 5s in target region. add a synthetic runner in infra-ci.
Tariq H.: ops runbook (temporary):
```
# scan proxies for headers
for r in eu-west-1 ap-southeast-1 us-west-2; do
  echo "region=$r"
  curl -sI https://edge-proxy.$r.internal/flags/feature_x_streaming | egrep -i 'ETag|X-Seq' || true
done
# if proxies missing X-Seq -> deploy proxy patch or restart containers
```
Marco L.: alert thresholds: global mismatch_rate > 0.01% over 15m OR any single-region > 0.1% over 5m -> page owners. We'll canary the fixes in ap-southeast-1 at 10% traffic, then expand to 50% after 1h if metrics stable.
Priya S.: I'll open PRs: proxy header passthrough, edge-client 304 fallback, and an infra-ci synthetic. I'll also wire the dashboard panel and the console toggle (minimal UI approved). tagging owners @Marco L. and @Tariq H..
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: edge-client 1.13.0 -> ap-southeast-1 (10%)
Priya S.: leaving a short follow-up note in #postmortems after 24h of canary telemetry. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Marco L.: i'll instrument the metric and add the grafana panel.
Tariq H.: will queue the proxy patch and the proxy scanner job.
